verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only adjacent privacy controls: RudderStack lets you store data on your own infrastructure in chosen regions, and its compliance toolkit can block, mask, or encrypt PII before it goes downstream. It also captures consent for GDPR/CCPA, which indirectly limits what data is kept, but no explicit retention or deletion feature is documented. missing for 10: configurable retention periods, a user/data deletion or suppression capability (e.g., a GDPR erasure API), agent/MCP-driven deletion workflows, independent or hands-on corroboration.
